extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media professionals (also investors, patients, and the general public)
extracted.subtask_description: An archived corporate news/press release page that lists AbbVie press releases, media resources, and site/legal notices intended to inform journalists, investors, patients, and the public. The page combines news items with media assets and short legal/disclaimer guidance about use and currency of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factual accuracy and update disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: "The information in the press releases on these pages was factually accurate on the date of publication. These press releases remain on AbbVie's website for historical purposes only. AbbVie assumes no duty to update the information to reflect subsequent developments. Readers should not rely upon the information in these pages as current or accurate after their publication dates."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This establishes that press releases are authoritative only as-of their publication date, are retained for historical/archive purposes, and AbbVie disclaims any obligation to update them. Journalists and readers should verify current accuracy before relying on archived content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press kits provide background information for journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our press kits are designed to provide journalists with a broad range of background information on our company."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press kits are intended as a media resource to supply company background and context; journalists should use them for factual/company background but still exercise independent verification as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image library supplies official media assets
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our media library provides you with our official AbbVie media including our logo, building and leaders."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The image/media library is the source for official photos and logos. Use of these assets may be subject to additional restrictions (see trademark and usage rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark and product name usage restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: "Unless otherwise specified, all product names appearing in this Internet site are trademarks owned by or licensed to AbbVie Inc., its subsidiaries or affiliates. No use of any AbbVie trademark, trade name, or trade dress in this site may be made without the prior written authorization of AbbVie Inc., except to identify the product or services of the company."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corporate policy requires prior written authorization to use AbbVie trademarks, trade names, or trade dress except for simple identification of AbbVie's products/services. Media and partners must obtain permission for other uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media engagement must follow channel-specific guidelines and legal considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: "We also welcome the opportunity to hear from you in these social channels, but remember we work in a highly-regulated industry with unique legal considerations. Before engaging, please read and adhere to our established community guidelines for each channel."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because of regulatory constraints, interactions on AbbVie's social channels are governed by platform-specific community guidelines and legal rules; users and media should consult and adhere to those guidelines before posting or engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: External link non-endorsement and leaving-site notice
rubrics_metrics.description: "Links which take you out of the AbbVie worldwide websites are not under the control of AbbVie, and AbbVie is not responsible for the contents of any such site or any further links from such site. AbbVie is providing these links to you only as a convenience and the inclusion of any link does not imply endorsement of the linked site by AbbVie."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers clicking links to third-party sites should not assume endorsement and should be aware AbbVie is not responsible for external content or links; the site explicitly warns users when they are about to leave the AbbVie domain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of media contacts and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists Media Resources such as "Images, Video, Media Contacts" and provides a "For more information Contact us »" prompt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site makes media contacts and resources available to support press inquiries; journalists should use the provided contact points for interview requests, clarification, or additional materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and news alert management
rubrics_metrics.description: The page offers "Get News Alerts by Email", "Subscribe", and "Subscription management" options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can sign up to receive press release updates via email and manage their subscriptions; this is the channel for receiving timely company news rather than relying on archived press releases alone.
